Thanks for sharing the first game you ever played with us Sora!
You always mentioned how 牧場物語 (Story of Seasons) was a special series to you, and now we finally know why!
While the new designs for the characters are nice, seeing them in the original forms while running around befriending everyone, avoiding your rivals, and opening the menu to equip items/tools is so nostalgic! Also, good job holding on your own in the never ending battle against insects in your new pace!

The first Story of Seasons I played was Harvest Moon: Back to Nature on the Playstation,  also known   「牧場物語：ハーベストムーン」in Japan.
(So, the subtitle for the game in Japanese is what the series used to be called in the west...I just found this out right now and  )
Anyways, I played the 2 (64) later on and I was shocked to see that despite releasing first and having the same characters, their personalities, relationships, and stories were completely different between the two games! I did enjoy the differences, but it makes me wonder why they kept the characters as is in the version I first played and not yours... A mystery for the ages!

Also there's a trick where you can raise Karen's affection really fast to max if hold your dog and keep showing it to her, and if you do it in the bar when time stops... !
Okay, it's a bug and is pretty much cheating, but I thought it was fair at the time since I already married her in the other games! 
But watching you play... makes me want to it right!
